_comment: Curated OpenAPI envelope for the checks plugin REST API. Operation summaries, descriptions and examples are mined from the plugin's rest-api*.md and composed in at build time (openapi_plugin_spec); this file supplies only the document-level metadata the generator cannot derive.

info.title: Gerrit Checks Plugin REST API
info.description: REST endpoints contributed by the checks plugin. Paths, parameters and payload schemas are generated statically from the plugin's REST bindings; human-authored summaries, descriptions and examples are mined from the plugin's rest-api*.md and merged in at build time.
